name: forget
description: DELETE/REMOVE one or more memories permanently. Use when user says 'forget', 'delete', 'remove', or 'erase' a memory. Supports a single memory_id, multiple memory_ids, or a search_query if the ID is unknown. This is for DELETION - use update_memory if you need to CHANGE a value instead.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to delete (optional if search_query provided)

memory_ids.description: Multiple memory IDs to delete in one call. Use this when the user names more than one memory ID. Hard capped at 10 IDs for safety.

search_query.description: Search keywords to find the memory to delete (e.g., 'favorite color', 'birthday'). Used if memory_id not provided.
